pr_title: Add support for v3 Coinbase API

<!--

Coinbase appear to have stopped issuing API keys that work with the v2 API. This pull request implements checking is an API key is for v2 or v3 and handles each approriately. I propose to depreciate v2 APIs in the future once I have determined the best way to handle the migration (bit short on time at the moment sadly) so here we just concentrate of fixing v3 API keys not working.

The main issue is that there are no tests testing the sensor entity, a follow-up PR adding that would be really nice.
It should not be a big effort considering everything else is tested, just add some test case using syrupy snapshots to assert the state is as expected.

Hi all. been looking into this myself, as I recently tried to update to the new API, and found home assistant doesn't work with it.

I've managed to produce some steps on Coinbase, however their Developer Portal seems to be down at the moment. (Will try again in a day or so)

1. Login to Coinbase.
2. click user icon > Settings > API (or click: [Coinbase API](https://www.coinbase.com/settings/api))
3. click OAuth.
you'll be greeted with a message such as "The Sign in with Coinbase API utilizes the OAuth2 protocol, enabling Coinbase users to grant OAuth client access to their account without sharing API keys or login credentials."
4. click "Create Client" button. It will take you to [Coinbase Legacy API](https://www.coinbase.com/settings/legacy_api) (Caution: light mode only!)
5. click "+ Create API Key with Coinbase Developer Platform"

Unfortunately, that's as far as I've got because I'm currently greeted with the following screenshot:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/99234901-1821-4c22-b1cb-2022b4c1f75a)

this does make me hopeful that something is being worked on their end. However, that's not to say we should stop pushing for the new API on HomeAssistant's end. They're obviously upgrading their API System and could well be fully de-funking the old system at some point.
